shared_elements: back of a schematic anthropomorphic monolithic figure
low-relief curvilinear loop/arc motifs across the upper back and shoulders
paired symmetrical arm-like curves meeting at the centre of the back
incised linear/geometric designs on the upper rear surface (head/neck area)
broad flat unmodelled body panel with sparse shallow relief
justification: Both depict the rear of a heavily schematic anthropomorphic monolith whose otherwise blank back carries shallow curvilinear loop motifs reading as arms/hands sweeping symmetrically toward the spine, plus incised linear ornament higher up — a fairly specific and shared scheme of decorating the back rather than the front. The clearest difference is that A adds a prominent concentric ring/disc and a banded girdle with a chevron beneath it, while B's upper decoration is a dense field of vertical incised bands and small figures with no disc or belt visible.
